retrievalProfile.description: A compartmentalized shadowbox layout featuring subjects posed within individual diorama-like shelves alongside vintage props.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex grid-based composition where human subjects and vintage objects are arranged within a dark, wooden shadowbox structure, utilizing a mix of bold display lettering and condensed sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast metallic textures against dark matte backgrounds
Text layered over structural dividers and negative space
Repetition of geometric shelf units creating a rhythmic grid
coreInvariants: Dark wooden grid structure defining the layout
Subjects wearing matching high-sheen metallic or sequined attire
Eclectic mix of vintage props like toys, instruments, and records

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects distributed across the grid: one standing full-height on the left, one seated top-right, and one reclining bottom-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized display text in the upper-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern starting from the top-left logo, moving through the central text blocks, and following the subjects' poses across the grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, recessed areas of the shadowbox provide depth and separation between elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal and muted wood tones for the structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Silver and metallic grey for the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and white for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark background and bright text/metallic clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant primary colors except for text
Maintain a desaturated, vintage photographic tone

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and stylized display faces
letterConstructionRules: Display text features exaggerated heights and varying baseline alignments
Secondary text uses tight, condensed vertical proportions
Outlines are used to separate text from complex backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' in the main logo has an elongated tail that underlines adjacent letters
Quotation marks are oversized and stylized
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, outlined display type paired with high-contrast condensed sans-serif for informational hierarchy.

preserve: The red outline on the main logo
The condensed verticality of the yellow text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy weight of the secondary text.
Approximates the stylized main logo feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark wooden shadowbox grid with various compartments. Place three women in silver sequined outfits in different sections (standing left, sitting top right, reclining bottom center). Fill other compartments with vintage toys, a baby carriage, and vinyl records.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large white display logo with a red outline in the top left. Add bright yellow condensed sans-serif text in the central and lower compartments, using ellipses to lead the eye between lines.

verificationChecks: Is the grid structure clearly visible?
Are the subjects wearing metallic/sequined clothing?
Is the main logo outlined in red?
Is the secondary text condensed and yellow?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subjects' faces
Verify the shadowbox has a sense of physical depth
Check that the metallic clothing has realistic specular highlights
Confirm the grid lines are straight and structural
recipe.reuseFormula: Shadowbox Grid + Metallic Fashion + Condensed Retro Type
